label: Town of Fairfax
header:
# Town of Fairfax municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the Elected Officers table and roster list five Selectboard members: Lauri Fisher (Chair, to 2029), Kurt Magnan (Vice Chair, 2028), Tim Burns (2027), Tim Germaine (2028), and Anna Hudson (2027). The town's 2026 results corroborate: Fisher won the 3-year seat (710 votes; results print 'Lauri Bellows Fisher') and Germaine the 2-year seat (670). The Secretary of State directory publishes no Fairfax roster.

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the 2026 Warning, Article 1, elects a Town Moderator for one year by Australian ballot, and the town's 2026 results re-elect Roberta Rodimer with 923 votes.

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the Town Clerk is absent from the report's Elected Officers table and from the 2026 Warning; the clerkship has been a full-time appointed staff position since 2023. Lynn Parah is recorded as the appointed holder.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Lynn Parah as Town Clerk of Fairfax.

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the report's records and the Selectboard minutes of February 20, 2023 show Amy Sears appointed to serve the remainder of a three-year treasurer term; she is recorded as the appointed holder.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Amy Sears as Town Treasurer of Fairfax.

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the Elected Officers table lists Johanna R. Blake as Collector of Delinquent Taxes, term to 2027; her signed FY2025 Collector's statement appears in the report.

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the Elected Officers table lists five elected Community Library Trustees: Barbara Murphy (Chair, 2027), Marti Sterin (2027), Elizabeth Griffin (2028), Sarah Barnes (2029), and Amy Palmer (2029); the 2026 results corroborate Barnes (638 votes) and Palmer (502).

Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the Elected Officers table lists five elected Cemetery Commissioners: Sally Sweet (Chair, 2030), Treavor Howard (2029), Tim Germaine (2028), David Shea (2027), and Robin Chapman (2026). Chapman's seat stood in 2026 and the official results show write-ins only, with the winner named in no town source, so four are minted and that seat is left unfilled.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Fairfax justices of the peace: Barbara Murphy, Steve Cormier, Julie Filiberti, Mary Kay Raymond, Jeffrey Bartley, Marjorie Ellsworth, Peter Fitzgerald, Gregory Hartmann, Robert Horr, Donna Meunier, James Minor, and Susan Mitchell.
Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the report's table lists the same twelve justices of the peace (printing 'Greg Hartman'; the listing's Gregory Hartmann governs).

jp_election.name: Town of Fairfax Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Fairfax justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Barbara Murphy, Steve Cormier, Julie Filiberti, Mary Kay Raymond, Jeffrey Bartley, Marjorie Ellsworth, Peter Fitzgerald, Gregory Hartmann, Robert Horr, Donna Meunier, James Minor, and Susan Mitchell. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
Town of Fairfax FY2025 Town Report (fairfax-vt.gov): the report's table lists the same twelve justices of the peace.
